verdict.description: Overall merge-readiness verdict. Use changes_requested when the PR should not merge yet; use incomplete when no trustworthy verdict can be reached.

summary.description: Free-text reviewer summary. Presentation only — carried into the posted comment verbatim, never parsed by the gate.

findings.description: Every issue worth surfacing, blocking or not. Empty when the diff looks fine.

severity.description: Human-facing severity label. Consumer policy decides how findings affect gating.

path.description: File path when the finding is localised to a file in the diff. Omit when not applicable.

line.description: One-based line number when the finding is localised to a line in the diff. Omit when not applicable.

body.description: Full, self-contained description of the issue. Never a bare '```' line on its own — that would close the comment's fenced sections early.
